photos.c: Above: With the familar backdrop of Battersea Power Station, 15 years-old James Hilston pauses for a photo call during a summer training session. In his first year in the Intermediate Boys age group James picked up 3rd place medal at the All-England Schools Champs. and ended the season with sprint pbs of 11.7, 22.9 and 50.15.

Below: English and International Schools Champion James Hilston is now down to 48.71 for 400m - and is still sixteen years old! With a talent like that, good luck with health and some hard graft he could go to the very top levels of our sport.
